name: Daido Steel Co., Ltd.
summary: Daido Steel Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of steel products in Japan and internationally. The company offers specialty steel for automotive parts, industrial machinery parts, electrical machinery parts, construction, and tool steel; stainless steel, nickel-based alloys, electrical and electronics parts, and magnetic material products; alloy powder; titanium products; and welding wire. It is also involved in manufacturing of specialty steel products and materials; distribution; sales of raw materials; real estate, insurance, and analysis businesses; and provision of transportation and logistics, machine maintenance, welfare, and golf course management services.
